title: Tourist Season, 2013 · the next night
logline: The night after the guest with the Sunday on his phone: the desk at 2 AM, no guests, and Wood drawing the bay on the pad from memory to see if it looks like the screen did. It doesn't. He's relieved. The line under the panels.

panels.composition: The motel desk at 2 AM. WOOD in the polo with the pad, drawing. The bell. The glass door dark.

image.prompt: a man in a maroon polo at a motel night desk drawing on a pad beside a bell with a dark glass door behind, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: The pad: the bay, in his line.

image.prompt: a pad with a drawing of a gray bay and a distant chimney in brush and ink, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: WOOD holding it up beside the dark window, where the phone was last night.

image.prompt: a man holding a drawn pad up beside a dark window at a motel desk, black ink with one spot tone
a man setting a pad down on a motel desk with a small satisfied look, black ink with one spot tone

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Doesn't look like that. Relieved. Hum line under.
